tasks.title: RPM from KV
tasks.solution: n = KV·U. With a prop on, RPM is 15–30 % lower because of the load.

tasks.title: Blade tip speed
tasks.solution: v = π·D·n, D in meters, n in rev/s. Above ~0.7 Mach (≈240 m/s) efficiency and noise get sharply worse.
